items.headline: Mazraoui forced off in Morocco win amid mounting injury crisis
items.summary: Noussair Mazraoui became Manchester United's latest injury casualty during the international break after being withdrawn from Morocco's Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against Lesotho.

items.headline: Man United injury tally reaches 11 players during international break
items.summary: With Mazraoui's withdrawal, Manchester United now has 11 players sidelined, including Amad Diallo, Matthijs de Ligt, Manuel Ugarte, Patrick Dorgu, Marcus Rashford, Kobbie Mainoo and Benjamin Seško.

items.headline: Dorgu hamstring concern forces Denmark withdrawal
items.summary: Patrick Dorgu lasted only 30 minutes in Denmark's clash with Wales before suffering a suspected hamstring injury and being sent home from international duty.

items.headline: Man United pursue legal action over JJ Gabriel exit
items.summary: Manchester United are weighing possible action after academy product JJ Gabriel departed the club, with Real Madrid and Bayern Munich among interested suitors.

items.headline: Barcelona open to January exit as Man United explore left-back deal
items.summary: Barcelona have warmed to a potential exit for left-back Alejandro Balde, with Manchester United and Liverpool both exploring a loan move in January.
